scripts.title: Gun Tycoon Script Auto Rebirth and More
scripts.features:
🔫 GUN TYCOON — MASTER SCRIPT ⚙️

📜 Game Supported: New Tycoon FPS Game (Collect, Upgrade, Battle)
🧪 Executor Tested: KRNL, Fluxus, Delta (Mobile Friendly)
👑 UI Library: Compiler Killer UI (Custom Tabs & Toggles)


🌟 FEATURES LIST & DESCRIPTION


🪙 Auto Collector

✅ Automatically collects cash when near the ATM machine.

⚠️ NOTE: You must stand near your ATM to trigger this. It does not teleport.



🪙 Auto Collector + TP

✅ Teleports you to the ATM and collects instantly.

🔁 Optional for AFK farm or when not nearby.

🔕 Turns off and returns you to your original location.



🔁 Anti-AFK

✅ Prevents kick for inactivity.

Perfect for long farms and overnight grinding.



---

♻️ Auto Rebirth

✅ Auto triggers rebirth when conditions are met.

Works with built-in server rebirth system.



---

🚷 Noclip

✅ Walk through walls and any objects.

🕹️ Toggle to activate or deactivate any time.



---

🧍 Walk Speed (Slider)

✅ Adjust your walk speed live.

📏 Range: 16 to 100+



---

🦘 Jump Power (Slider)

✅ Set your jump height dynamically.

📏 Range: 50 to 150+


🚀 Infinite Jump (Toggle)

✅ Jump endlessly mid-air.

Perfect for escape, mobility, or glitches.


👁️ ESP (Name)

✅ Shows all player names above their heads.

🧑 Fully dynamic. Works on all players.



🦴 ESP Skeleton (Fixed)

✅ Displays skeleton ESP for all players.

🎯 Helps in PvP tracking across walls.



🔫 Infinite Ammo (Guns)

✅ Your gun never runs out of bullets.

💥 Works on all in-game guns.


🔁 Rapid Fire (Guns)

✅ Removes delay between shots.

⚡ Max DPS against other players.



🔄 Custom Reload Speed (Slider)

✅ Adjust how fast your gun reloads.

📏 Range: Super slow → Instant reload.



🧍 Bring Players To You

✅ Teleports all players to 1m in front of you.

🔫 Easy for killing, slapping, or trapping.

🔁 Toggle ON/OFF anytime.
